phylum_df <- 
  scaled_physeq %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Phylum") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group))

phylum_df %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarize(mean_RelAbund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_RelAbund)) %>%
  datatable()
# Make a list of phyla the top phyla 
top10_phyla <- 
  phylum_df %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarize(mean_PercAbund = mean(Abundance)) %>%
  arrange(-mean_PercAbund) %>%
  head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Phylum)
top10_phyla
## [1] "Bacillota"               "Bacteroidota"           
## [3] "Actinomycetota"          "Pseudomonadota"         
## [5] "Verrucomicrobiota"       "Thermodesulfobacteriota"
## [7] "Patescibacteria"         "Cyanobacteriota"
phylum_df %>%
filter(Phylum %in% top10_phyla) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = Iron.intake, y = Abundance, fill = Iron.intake, color = Iron.intake)) +
geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7) +
facet_wrap(~Phylum, scales = "free_y") +
scale_fill_manual(values = iron_colors) +
scale_color_manual(values = iron_colors) +
theme_bw() +
labs(title = "Top 10 Phyla by Iron Intake", x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance") +
theme(legend.position = "none")

###INTERPRETATION 2: Which phyla in your dataset have the highest relative abundances? What are their abundances? We will focus on these phyla for plotting below. :)

genus_df <- 
  scaled_physeq %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Genus") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group))

top20_genera <- 
  genus_df %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarize(mean_RelAbund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_RelAbund)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(Genus)

genus_df %>%
filter(Genus %in% top20_genera) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = Iron.intake, y = Abundance, fill = Iron.intake, color = Iron.intake)) +
geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7) +
facet_wrap(~Genus, scales = "free_y") +
scale_fill_manual(values = iron_colors) +
scale_color_manual(values = iron_colors) +
theme_bw() +
labs(title = "Top 20 Genera by Iron Intake", x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance") +
theme(legend.position = "none")

set.seed(238428)

ASV_df <- 
  scaled_physeq %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) >= 10, .) %>%   # adjust threshold
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x)) %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group))

top20_ASVs <- 
  ASV_df %>%
  group_by(OTU) %>%   # sometimes this column may be ASV; check names(ASV_df)
  summarize(mean_RelAbund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_RelAbund)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(OTU)

ASV_df %>%
filter(OTU %in% top20_ASVs) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = Iron.intake, y = Abundance, fill = Iron.intake, color = Iron.intake)) +
geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
geom_jitter(aes(shape = Iron.intake), width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
facet_wrap(~OTU, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
scale_fill_manual(values = iron_colors) +
scale_color_manual(values = iron_colors) +
scale_shape_manual(values = iron_shapes) +
labs(title = "Top 20 ASVs by Iron Intake", x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance") +
theme_bw() +
theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))

# Top 10 phyla
phylum_df %>%
filter(Phylum %in% top10_phyla) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = factor(ID), y = Abundance, fill = Phylum)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9) +
facet_grid(~Iron.intake, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
theme_bw() +
labs(title = "Top 10 Phyla by Individual Sample", x = "Sample ID", y = "Relative abundance") +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

# top 10 genera
genus_df %>%
filter(Genus %in% top20_genera) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = factor(ID), y = Abundance, fill = Genus)) +
geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.9) +
facet_grid(~Iron.intake, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
theme_bw() +
labs(title = "Top 10 Genera by Individual Sample", x = "Sample ID", y = "Relative abundance") +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Make sure Iron.intake is the testing variable
sample_data(scaled_physeq)$Iron.intake <- factor(sample_data(scaled_physeq)$Iron.intake)
sample_data(scaled_physeq)$Iron.intake <- relevel(sample_data(scaled_physeq)$Iron.intake, ref = "HC50")

# Check group sizes
table(sample_data(scaled_physeq)$Iron.intake)
## 
##  HC50 HC500 
##    24    26
# Convert phyloseq object to DESeq2 object
dds <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(scaled_physeq, ~ Iron.intake)
## converting counts to integer mode
# Run DESeq2
dds <- DESeq(dds, test = "Wald", fitType = "parametric")
## estimating size factors
## estimating dispersions
## gene-wise dispersion estimates
## mean-dispersion relationship
## final dispersion estimates
## fitting model and testing
## -- replacing outliers and refitting for 264 genes
## -- DESeq argument 'minReplicatesForReplace' = 7 
## -- original counts are preserved in counts(dds)
## estimating dispersions
## fitting model and testing
# Extract HC500 vs HC50 results
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("Iron.intake", "HC500", "HC50"), alpha = 0.05)

# Convert results to dataframe and add taxonomy
deseq_ASV_results <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
rownames_to_column("OTU") %>%
left_join(as.data.frame(tax_table(scaled_physeq)) %>% rownames_to_column("OTU"), by = "OTU") %>%
arrange(padj)

# View all results
datatable(deseq_ASV_results)
# Significant ASVs only
sig_deseq_ASVs <- deseq_ASV_results %>%
filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05) %>%
arrange(padj)

datatable(sig_deseq_ASVs)
## not getting anyting sig. after correction
# Differential abundance at Genus level with DESeq2

# Agglomerate counts to Genus level
genus_physeq <- scaled_physeq %>%
tax_glom(taxrank = "Genus")

# Make sure metadata variable is factor
sample_data(genus_physeq)$Iron.intake <- factor(sample_data(genus_physeq)$Iron.intake)
sample_data(genus_physeq)$Iron.intake <- relevel(sample_data(genus_physeq)$Iron.intake, ref = "HC50")

# Convert phyloseq object to DESeq2 object
dds_genus <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(genus_physeq, ~ Iron.intake)
## converting counts to integer mode
# Run DESeq2
dds_genus <- DESeq(dds_genus, test = "Wald", fitType = "parametric")
## estimating size factors
## estimating dispersions
## gene-wise dispersion estimates
## mean-dispersion relationship
## final dispersion estimates
## fitting model and testing
## -- replacing outliers and refitting for 14 genes
## -- DESeq argument 'minReplicatesForReplace' = 7 
## -- original counts are preserved in counts(dds)
## estimating dispersions
## fitting model and testing
# Extract HC500 vs HC50 results
res_genus <- results(dds_genus, contrast = c("Iron.intake", "HC500", "HC50"), alpha = 0.1)

# Convert to dataframe + taxonomy
deseq_genus_results <- as.data.frame(res_genus) %>%
rownames_to_column("FeatureID") %>%
left_join(as.data.frame(tax_table(genus_physeq)) %>% rownames_to_column("FeatureID"), by = "FeatureID") %>%
mutate(Genus_label = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", FeatureID, Genus)) %>%
select(Genus_label, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj, FeatureID) %>%
arrange(padj)

# View all results
datatable(deseq_genus_results)
# Significant genera only
sig_deseq_genera <- deseq_genus_results %>%
filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.1) %>%
arrange(padj)

datatable(sig_deseq_genera)
lab_df <- sig_deseq_genera %>%
select(Genus_label, log2FoldChange, padj) %>%
mutate(label = paste0("log2FC = ", round(log2FoldChange, 2),
                      "\nFDR = ", signif(padj, 2)))

plot_df <- genus_df %>%
filter(Genus %in% c("Romboutsia", "Adlercreutzia")) %>%
left_join(lab_df, by = c("Genus" = "Genus_label"))

ggplot(plot_df,
aes(x = Iron.intake, y = Abundance,
fill = Iron.intake, color = Iron.intake)) +
geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.65) +
geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
facet_wrap(~Genus, scales = "free_y") +
geom_text(data = plot_df %>% distinct(Genus, label),
aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = label),
inherit.aes = FALSE,
vjust = 1.2,
fontface = "bold",
size = 4) +
scale_fill_manual(values = iron_colors) +
scale_color_manual(values = iron_colors) +
theme_bw() +
labs(title = "Differentially Abundant Genera", x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance") +
theme(legend.position = "none")
